description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

You develop a magnetic pull on others. Everyone knows where you are in a room, and when you speak the crowd listens. Your Status counts as one Tier higher, you gain +10 Fellowship and the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.WCXnFSV4WOSmzzc4]{Inspiring} (3), @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.XU7D9CCmumuhqDUi]{Public Speaker} (3) and @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.ZWcTbeK8i9vKph2a]{Master Orator} Talents. Its almost impossible for you to not draw the attention of others and you get a -30 Stealth modifier around sentient beings. Magnetic Presence doesnt cause Fear in others (see @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.journal.JournalEntry.uDGFazW9Nr0N6ABS.JournalEntryPage.9sK84Dvy3Ng36qXp#reactions-to-mutations]{Reactions to Mutations}). Further levels in this mutation will not give any additional modifiers, but will advance the Talents 1 step (not 3).
